title: Road Weather Hazard Alerting

engineFeatures.meaning: the cohort the subject joined, used for the time-based split

label: For "Road Weather Hazard Alerting": Forecast ice, flooding and low visibility on road segments from sensors and weather models and alert maintenance teams and drivers in time to treat or warn. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Air temperature as the only input.
